title: EpiModel Extensions for High-Performance Computing
text: EpiModel core R package simulating mathematical models infectious disease dynamics using stochastic, individual-based network models based exponential-family random graph models (ERGMs). EpiModel handles network estimation (netest), epidemic simulation (netsim), analysis results single machine. EpiModelHPC replace . Instead, wraps extends EpiModel’s simulation engine functionality needed models become computationally intensive single workstation: Parallelization: Distributes simulation replicates across multiple cores HPC node. Checkpointing: Automatically saves intermediate simulation state configurable intervals, long-running jobs can resume left interrupted (e.g., wall-time limit). Scenario Batching: Runs multiple parameter scenarios (defined via EpiModel::create_scenario_list) batched parallel jobs, deterministic file naming downstream merging. Result Merging: Merges outputs distributed batch jobs back single simulation objects tidy data frames analysis. simulations complete reasonable time laptop, likely need package. EpiModelHPC designed point need run large numbers replicates, sweep across many scenarios, model’s per-replicate runtime exceeds practical without job scheduling.
